title: HORUS cockpit host registry, schema version 1
description: File cockpit-hosts.json, served next to the cockpit's index.html. A standalone cockpit lists every host it federates; the embedded starter generates a file with one host. The cockpit validates it at start-up and calls no host when it is invalid (ADR-0014).

mode.description: oidc: the cockpit signs in as a public OIDC client with PKCE. host-session: embedded only; the host's own session cookie authenticates, and the cockpit sends the host's CSRF token.

scopes.description: Scopes for the sign-in request. openid is always added.

tokenMode.description: per-host (default): one access token per host, requested with that host's scope, so each token's audience is one host. shared: one token whose audience lists every host; weaker isolation, fewer requests to the identity provider.

redirectPath.description: Path of the sign-in callback, relative to the cockpit. The cockpit adds a trailing slash, so the redirect URI registered at the identity provider is <cockpit>/auth/callback/ by default.

hosts.description: Hosts in display order. The supported number of hosts per cockpit is pending PD-046 (proposed 15); the cockpit shows a warning above that.

environmentBanner.description: Text shown on every screen, for example PRODUCTION.

id.description: Stable id, used in URLs and merged lists.

baseUrl.description: Origin and optional path prefix of the host, without a trailing slash. https, or http only for localhost. Empty string means the same origin (embedded).

scope.description: OAuth scope that yields a token with this host's audience. Required in tokenMode per-host.
